main_claim: Punahele Soriano, in a UFC.com feature ahead of his booked fight with Donchenko, says he prefers staying under the radar and calls Donchenko a scary, wild young fighter.
note: Soriano is booked against him ('Saturday's meeting with Donchenko at Accor Arena') and assesses him: '100 percent, man; scary dude, wild dude... he's young and has that young man's fire and vigor'. The booking is only the premise of the feature, so next fight is no; Donchenko's share is one quote in a long Soriano profile, so only_mentioned is arguable.

main_claim: MMA Mania previews five UFC Paris main-card fights and picks Soriano to beat Donchenko by decision.
note: The writer analyses both men ('Donchenko's takedown defense is still fairly unproven', 'exciting and crafty striker') and ends 'Prediction: Soriano via decision'; the booking is the premise of a pick, so no fact. He is one of ten fighters in a five-fight preview, so only_mentioned is arguable, and the section is as much assessment as prediction.

main_claim: A DraftKings bettor picks Donchenko to beat Soriano by finish at UFC Paris.
note: 'I'm taking him to win this contest at +100 by KO/TKO/DQ or submission' is a pundit's pick; records and the June Berggren knockout are background. The piece covers both fighters, so one_of_several, though he carries the headline and the bet, which could be read as main_subject.

main_claim: UFC fans are angry after commentator Jon Anik revealed the UFC has held internal conversations about an immediate Topuria-Gaethje rematch.
note: The new information is Anik's leak that 'the promotion has held internal conversations about running things back'; 'internal conversations' is talks, so rumour, though a named commentator stating it could be read as reported. The headline frames the fans' reaction ('Topuria needs to win another fight before any rematch'), so source fans / act steers_him is arguable; his disfigured face is background recap, and his website statement is quoted ('I believe in God's will...'), so he speaks.

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says nobody has contacted him about the rumoured UFC 335 fight with Topuria but he would love to smash his head in.
note: Pimblett is only rumoured against him, so other_fighter_side; 'I'd love to smash his head in, lad' is trash talk aimed at him. The rumour has substance (Tim Welch, December 12, UFC 335) and Anik's 'internal conversations' about Gaethje vs Topuria 2 add to it, so next_fight at rumour; it is Pimblett's story and a callout, so only_mentioned is arguable, but the article adds two live rumours about Topuria's next fight.

main_claim: Umar Nurmagomedov says his brother Usman, a PFL free agent, can compete with anyone in the UFC lightweight division.
note: Topuria appears once, in a list of names Usman could compete with ('Gaethje, Ilia (Topuria), Arman, (Mauricio) Ruffy, anybody'). Nobody does anything regarding him, so act is none_of_these.

main_claim: Topuria's return is rumoured for December with Paddy Pimblett as the leading candidate, and Sean O'Malley says he now leans toward Pimblett in that fight.
note: Tim Welch's 'Hay rumores de un Paddy Pimblett contra Topuria en diciembre' gives the rumour who and when, and the writer stresses 'aún no está confirmado nada', so next_fight at rumour, though a reader could call it status_update ('su regreso'); the headline quote is O'Malley's pick 'Ahora mismo me inclino por Paddy', with Pimblett's 'Me encantaría aplastarle la cabeza' as an alternative calls_him_out. Attention is shared with Pimblett, and his letter to his son is quoted only in an inline related headline (page furniture), so he_speaks is no.

main_claim: Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Paris for his fourth straight UFC win.
note: A fight report with scores (30-27, 30-27, 29-28) and two knockdowns; the outlet says he announced it on Instagram ('Про це він повідомив у себе в Instagram'), so himself is arguable, but no words of his are quoted beyond the recalled 'хороші друзі' from an earlier occasion. His callout of Daniel Rodriguez is a wish, so next fight is no.

main_claim: Arman Tsarukyan says he wants at least five lightweight title defenses to beat Makhachev's record and expects Topuria to be his first challenger.
note: Tsarukyan's story; Topuria is the opponent he wants for his first defense, with a recap of the Gaethje loss, plus 'he's an incredible fighter' and a guess ('Either he's going to be super good or... he's not going to recover', 'I think he's going to be more motivated') and a forecast that the UFC will give Ilia 'someone easy'. The guess and matchmaking forecast are no act, so none_of_these is arguable; the assessment paragraph could push him to one_of_several.

main_claim: Topuria breaks his silence after the Gaethje loss with a video message to his son Hugo about not being afraid to lose.
note: His own words to his son are quoted at length ('No que ganes siempre, sino que nunca tengas miedo de perder'); a message to his son is personal_life per the guide, though the closing 'We are back' and 'rompe el silencio' could be read as status_update or the whole as a no_fact reflection. The facial damage and vision problems are the writer's recap of the June fight, so health is no.

main_claim: MMA Fighting lists the UFC Paris results, including Donchenko beating Soriano by unanimous decision.
note: One line on a results page: 'Daniil Donchenko def. Punahele Soriano via unanimous decision (30-27 x2, 29-28)'. His bout on a results page is a result, but a name in a list is only_mentioned.

main_claim: Islam Makhachev says he hopes Topuria comes back strong from the Gaethje loss and could be champion again if he refocuses.
note: Makhachev never fought him, so other_fighter_side; 'I see Ilia is a good fighter. He has good punch, he has good wrestling, good skills on the ground' is an assessment of his level, though 'Sure, he will be back' and 'maybe he will be champion again' are hopes and guesses, so none_of_these is arguable. The June loss is background.

main_claim: Donchenko will fight Punahele Soriano on September 5 at UFC Fight Night in Paris.
note: A booking announcement with nobody speaking: 'проведе свій наступний поєдинок 5 вересня на турнірі UFC Fight Night у Парижі', stated flatly as set; the outlet names no source, so reported is arguable. The Berggren knockout and his 3-0 record are background.

main_claim: A photo caption shows Joel Alvarez fighting Yaroslav Amosov at UFC 328 on May 9, 2026, with no article text.
note: The only content is the caption 'Joel Alvarez (red gloves) fights Yaroslav Amosov (blue gloves) during UFC 328'; the rest is site boilerplate. The caption records a three-month-old fight with no outcome, so no new fact and nobody does anything regarding him (none_of_these); reports_an_event is arguable for the caption, and not_in_content if a caption is counted as furniture.

main_claim: Donchenko says he earned between 20 and 50 thousand dollars for his TUF final win and asked Dana White to sign his teammate Dmytro instead of paying him.
note: He speaks in a Q&A about his purse ('більше 20 і менше 50 тисяч доларів') and his request to White to sign his friend; money is personal_life, though the revealed request to the UFC president is a past negotiation that could be none_of_these. The Soriano booking on September 5 is a closing line, so next fight is no; the TUF win is recalled, so result is no.
